findings.title: Root Account MFA Missing
findings.recommendation: Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on the root account immediately.

findings.title: SSH Open To Internet
findings.recommendation: Restrict inbound port 22 access to specific trusted IP ranges instead of the entire internet.

findings.title: SIP Port Exposed to Internet
findings.evidence: Public inbound UDP rule includes port 5060, commonly used by SIP signaling. Protocol: UDP, Port Range: 5060-5060, Source: 0.0.0.0/0
findings.recommendation: Restrict SIP signaling access to expected provider, SBC, proxy, trunk, or trusted network ranges where architecture allows. Use authenticated/encrypted signaling and layered controls as appropriate.

findings.title: SIP-TLS Port Exposed to Internet
findings.evidence: Public inbound TCP rule includes port 5061, commonly used for SIP over TLS. Protocol: TCP, Port Range: 5061-5061, Source: 0.0.0.0/0
findings.recommendation: Confirm that direct internet exposure is required and restrict access to expected communications peers/providers where feasible.

findings.title: Broad UDP Port Range Exposed to Internet
findings.evidence: Public inbound UDP rule exposes port range 10000-20000 (10001 ports). Broad UDP ranges may be used for real-time media/RTP or other UDP-based workloads, depending on application configuration. Source: 0.0.0.0/0
findings.recommendation: Confirm the range is required, narrow it where operationally possible, and restrict sources to trusted communication peers/providers or network boundaries where architecture allows.

findings.title: IMDSv2 Not Enforced
findings.evidence: Instance metadata options allow requests without mandatory session tokens, meaning IMDSv1 may be available.
findings.recommendation: Require IMDSv2 by configuring instance metadata HttpTokens to 'required' after validating application compatibility.

findings.title: EBS Volume Is Not Encrypted
findings.evidence: This EBS volume is not encrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Use encrypted EBS volumes for data at rest. For existing unencrypted volumes, plan migration to an encrypted replacement following normal AWS operational procedures.

findings.title: Scanner Permission Error: Access Denied for Describe Hub
findings.evidence: Lacks 'securityhub:DescribeHub' permission. AWS error code: AccessDenied.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the scanner IAM identity is granted the 'securityhub:DescribeHub' permission.
